job.job_description:
We are growing and are looking to expand our team with some rockstar engineers.

We are looking for an experienced Java Full Stack developer to help us enhance the product, ensure we scale seamlessly to grow and serve a global userbase of several millions, and venture into newer business avenues with our product/technology.

Role overview

We are looking for a Backend Application Developer (Java+Python) with experience in building high-performing, scalable, enterprise-grade applications.

Professional profile we are looking for

Must have

3-5 years of experience in developing highly scalable applications as a backend developer (Java + Python). Python(Django) fluency is a must.
Working knowledge/experience with the Spring Boot framework.
Knowledge of the Java Concurrency Utilities framework.
Solid understanding of micro-services and REST APIs

Bonus

Knowledge or understanding of Apache Kafka, Cloud computing in AWS
Understanding of any front end frameworks (Angular/Vue/React)

Python Backend Engineer 3

Behavioral traits that will help you succeed in this role

1. Collaborative - We are a tight team and need to move fast!
2. Communicative - We are solving some really niche and complex problems. Communication is key. This also means good documentation.
3. Analytical - Our product is quite complex. Critical thinking is a must for you to succeed.
4. Growth-oriented - If you focus on your growth diligently, the product will get better for sure :)
